label: texo-384/decoder

provenance.summary: Texo's mBART decoder (2 layers, d_model 384, 16 heads x 24, FFN 1536, vocab 687) with 2 layers unrolled 16 greedy steps per dispatch: argMax of each step's logits feeds the next step's embedding gather in-graph. Static [1,16,24,S]/[1,16,S,24] self-attention caches in and out (ping-pong), one-hot outer-product cache update, causal mask rows and position embeddings from one table gather per dispatch.

source.model: Texo / FormulaNet as shipped in LatexGen public/models/texo (fp32 ONNX: encoder_model.onnx, decoder_model_merged.onnx)

recordedFrom.recorder: bench/webnn/ir-record.js (Proxy around MLGraphBuilder; shapes are the backend's)
recordedFrom.label: texo-decoder-k16

folds: sqrt(384) embedding scale into the token table
1/sqrt(24) attention scale into the Q third of the packed QKV weight and bias
mBART position offset 2 into the position table
position embedding + one-hot row + causal mask row = one [S, 384+S+S] table, one gather per dispatch for all k positions
K cache stored transposed so q.K^T is a plain matmul; every per-head reshape is a view (no transposes)
weight constants created once and shared by all unrolled steps

fusions.causalMask: gathered row of a constant [S,S] table

note: One operand namespace: graph inputs keep their names, constants are k<N>, op results v<N>. Multi-output ops (split) list every result in `outputs`.

outputs.name: tokens
outputs.role: argMax token of each unrolled step, int32 [k]; the only output a consumer reads

outputs.name: cache_kT0_out
outputs.role: K^T cache after k steps (bind as next dispatch's cache_kT0)
